real_defects.issue: parseUniformat read a malformed 3-digit code ('B201') as level-2 'B20' (regex let a stray digit follow the level-2 digits). Fixed: two or four digits after the letter (?!\d); test 'a malformed code is not read as its first three characters'.

a door aggregated into an IfcCurtainWall inherited the curtain wall's code: B2010 Exterior Walls even with IsExternal true (should be B2030) or false (C1020). Fixed: doors never inherit; a door in a curtain wall takes B2030/C1020 by its own flag, else the curtain wall's (assumed exterior); test 'a door that is part of a curtain wall is a door, not wall'.

coverings inherited their aggregate's code: ROOFING in an IfcRoof gave B1020 (not B3010 Roof Coverings), FLOORING in an IfcStair gave C2010 (not C2020 Stair Finishes). Fixed: coverings keep their own element; in a roof anything but CEILING is B3010, on a stair or ramp C2020; test 'coverings in a roof or stair are roof coverings and stair finishes'.
